sanskrit: ninīśiścaiva bhāntañca haścanyetāścatuścaye pigristhiśca mamūyaśca yonivātañca phit punaḥ saśca naśca iti khyātā dvitīyāvaraṇe nyaset veścarūśca tide svaśca śivaye bhasmadaśvanā gurvaśca yaśca oṃ bhūta pretīśca nāśca vai ? gaśca śīraśca vā teṣāñcaturāvaraṇe sthitiḥ aśvahāpaśvaścaiva śiśca yaśca saguśca va yathāgarāgavedyāya yayera ijyohya bhuśca not pānāyāhāśca vā aścadyoṃ hyotā aśca aścaja dyontāśca ne bhavabhyāhyā gāvapinteśca yūśca yū nenaśā yo vṛṣaścaiva guṃguṃ ghorāśca dyāśca te ekādaśapade lākhyā sarveṣāmātmanaḥ phalam vyaścaśca paścaśca mithaśca mīnātmā ca na śudyāyavadyaṃ supudena sumedyo prataddhura pāyūniya tattmaśca yaramin ma anāni ca vyośiyaśca vāyaśca nānādyośca yaścapi evaṃ pañcadaśe vṛttaṃ vyomavyāpiriti smṛtam vyomavyāpi mahāmantramṛṣicchande devatān kuru atha sadyāmi mantrāṇāṃ uddhāraṇaṃ vadāmyaham pūrvakānārcyamūlena praṇavaṃ dīpakaṃ nyaset veśca vaśca visargeṇa mokṣaśca vaśaka eva ca raśca taśca visargeṇa steduhānostathaiva ca dyānabhak bhaśca nadrāśca makārasavisargayut savisargo makāraśca tanmaṃtaścaiva eva ca paśca vaiśca yo yaśca ruśca nayastathā

oṃ svaṃ ha phaśca yānyā ta brahmatāśca tathaiva ca maśca bhūma anebhyo sa visargāma eva ca taśca tāśca tathaivāmāndena lākārameva ca peśca viśca tathādhī ca corvaṣṭa vastu eva ca rakaṃpa phalasañcaiva namasyaśca tu sañcarū evaṃ sadyādimantrāṇāṃ bindvatītaṃ śataṃ bhavet * * * * arañcaiva citraśca tathaiva ca sahaśca bhaśca bhitriṃśadakṣaraṃ ṣaṭ ṣaṣṭhivāmamantrakam trayastriṃśadīśvarañcaiva praṇavena samāyutam kauśikaṃ kāśyapañcaiva bhāradvājo'trireva ca anuṣṭup tṛṣṭupaścaiva āryovṛttakameva ca brahmāviṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ ṛgyajussāmātharvaśca caturvedāntasārakam gandhabrahmamiti proktaṃ bhajyamaṅgamiti smṛtam sūkṣmarūpaṃ śivaṃ proktaṃ sthūlarūpaṃ sadāśivam oṅkāraśca yavośi ca te śuyaśca punaśca phaṭ sānte ca sakasā bhūyo vaścajassavisargakaḥ vāravyastathaiveha sau dīrghāśca dvitīyakaḥ ṛkāro parvayārṇaśca ikāraṃ praṇavastataḥ daśapraśca tathāgaśca heścamriyonta eva ca mokte ṣaṣṭhasya mārgasya kāruśāśavagākarī lakārastucchadekāra parunā name pathe vye sa sā hvūya ca taṃ hyā ca kilikeśaśca yastathā svaśau śiyavāvākṣuśca vipārucāśca ma eva ca prahapralihaśiṣyā ca sa ta ghātaścaturdaśa

yabhannā svājñahājñāśca jñakāraṃ punarāścaśī khā cā cantapunargā ca haśca mo ca tato'kṣaraḥ tathā tatra vakāraśca haśca yaśca yavo tataḥ gamo svātmāśca vandaśca śastaṃgaśca phaṭ ca yat yaśca taśca tathotkāraḥ parvau praṇava eva ca anante vāsugo labdhajuhū prabheda ūṣmaṇaḥ oṅkārādi hakārāntaṃ uddharetkramaśaḥ punaḥ jvanī paratastārvyācchivāmekādaśākṣaram aghorāstraṃ tatastriṃśadvādaśākṣaralakṣitam netratryakṣaraṃ tasmādvindyānāmālayaṃ param hṛdayādi vibhāgena kathitaṃ siddhimuktidam padabrahmasthanāmāni pañcānāṃ pañca vrinyaset ādyante kāmanirdeśo vibhaktyante tu nāmāni hārdantu pañcamastasmā triṃśaddikṣu ca mūrchitam pañcākṣaraṃ caturthyantaṃ tāmāvedyamataḥ param śavya sarvātmanā yugma padamekaṃ caturthakam dviriśyā sapadādekamaṣṭamācchaivamakṣaram pūrvameva dvirabhyāsātpadamanyākṣaraṃ vinā annaṃ chindudvayaṃ kṣīṇa na padādaṣṭamaṃ padam tato mantrasamāptyarthaṃ muñca muñca padātpadam vāmapādamūrdhvapāda sthūlasūkṣmadvayakam anantaṃ piṅgalaṃ tasmāt samāpte navamākṣaram rudranāmaṃ caturthyantaṃ trimūrtiṃ tribhireva ca yanati pūrvavattābhyāṃ yathā saṃsthantu paiṅgalam dvitīyamaparaṃ tasmāt vidyāṅgaṃ śiraso'kṣaram

yanatī tu tatastasmādvāmadevapadānuge lakārānādyamaṃ bhūyasthāpya tatra dvitīyakam balakārākṣarādvanyesva śivārgaṃ paiṅgalaṃ nyaset pañcākṣarācchivācchaiṣā ṣaṣṭhamañca tathokṣaram brahmāsvādestṛtīyasya pṛṣṭhamadhye padasya tu tṛtīyantu tataśśaivaṃ saptaviṃśakameva ca idameva padaṃ sūkṣma * binduparikīrtitam trimūrttyantena tasmānniyamākṣaradvayam vidyāṅgā stṛtīyantu ekārān parato'kṣaram aghorāsrātmakādvarṇa saptamāṣṭamaghorataḥ paiṅgalāghokṣaraṃ sthāpya taccatvāro paristhitam ekādaśamaghorāstraṃ takāraṃ savisargakam ravyokāraśca na tastājñeyasteyā śaivameva ca caturthasya tu gāyatryā ṣaṣṭhamādyākṣaratrayam padatrayottaraṃ tasmāt gāyatryarṇaṃ catuṣṭayam vāmadehottare hārdai ṣaṣṭhaṃ gāyatryakṣaram aṣṭamaṃ nākṣarañcaiva mamanaskaṃ samanvitam sparśantamātṛkasyāpi padasyordhvamathottaram śaivavargādbindusaṃyuktaṃ brahmāścaiva mataḥ param dhiyatpade phapotānte aṣṭamaṃ śoṣṭamakṣaram ananteśaṃ caturthyantaṃ vohādyaṃ vai śavamaṣṭamam vinyasedekarudrāntaṃ mūrchitamanokṣaram anuṣṭup chandassamāyuktaṃ trayo mantrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ prātarutthāpayenmantraṃ śuddhasthānagate satī vṛkṣasaṅghe ca gokoṣṭhe payi bhasmani gomaye

śilāñca parvatāgreṣu kuryādāvaśyakaṃ budhaḥ kuryādāvaśyakaṃ kāryaṃ maunī bhūtaśivadvijaḥ evaṃ kṛtvā tu tanmantrī gacchetpratijalaṃ budhaḥ mṛtpiṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇe haste gṛhṇīyāttu jalaṃ budhaḥ daśadhā kṣālayedvāraṃ mṛtpiṇḍena punaḥ punaḥ gandhalepakṣayaharaṃ śaucaṃ kṛtvā śanaiśśanaiḥ triguṇaṃ vānaprasthānāṃ yatīnāntu caturguṇam udaṅmukhataprāṅmukho bhūtvā śikhāmābandhayedvidhi nāntarjalena tiṣṭhañca na hasanna bruvan tathā * * * * * * * * reṇaiva sarvamācaret brahmāviṣṇuśca rudraśca maghavāniti śaivikam aṅgulyagre ṛṣitīrthaṃ aṅgulīmadhye ca daivikam aṅguṣṭhāṃgulirekhāyāṃ brāhmatīrthamudāhṛtam tṛṃ pipedṛgyajussamāṃ prīṇāṃ tadviparimṛjet padbhyāmabhyukṣaṇaṃ kuryādbhūmadevyāḥ priyaṃ bhavet aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyantu cakṣuṣo samupaspṛśet sarvāṅgulyā spṛśe hṛdayaṃ śiro vai sarvatoṅgulam śiraḥ pādau tathābhyukṣaṃ ṛṣīṇāṃ sapta tṛptaye nāsau vai sparśanaprītiḥ arcinyāmadhidevatā mūrdhni saṃsparśane caiva sarvadevapriyaṃ bhavet aṅguṣṭhenā'sya saṃspṛśya paścādācamanaṃ bhavet mṛtpiṇḍaṃ gomayaṃ puṣpaṃ tilamāmalakaṃ kuśam ācamya vidhivatpūrvaṃ pādau hastau ca kṣālayet sadyojātena mantreṇa mṛtpiṇḍantu tridhā bhavet pūrvaṃ tatpuruṣeṇaiva aghoreṇa tu dakṣiṇe

astreṇa prakṣipeddikṣu daśasvapi yathākramam śiro vaktrañca hṛdaya guhyaṃ pādau vibhāgaśaḥ uttareṇa mṛdañcaiva śivatīrthaṃ prakalpayet pañcabrahmaśivāṅgaiśca abhiṣekaṃ prakalpayet kalaśamudrāntu baddhvā tu prāsādenābhiṣecayet paścātsnānaṃ samāsādya ācamya ca yathā vidhi tatpuruṣeṇa mantreṇa japedaṣṭaśataṃ punaḥ paścādācamanaṃ kuryādadhikrāviṇṇeti prokṣayet upaspṛśya tato japtvā pañcabrahmasabhāṅgakaiḥ devān ṛṣīn pitṛṃścaiva tarpayitvā yathākramam pitṝṇāṃ sadyamantreṇa evamevaṃ krameṇa tu devī kena tu tīrthena devān tarpyodapuṣpayuk paitṛkena tu tīrthena pitṝn sarvāṃśca tarpayet ācamya tu vidhānena vyomavyāpī tathaiva ca huṅkāreṇa tu mantreṇa tīrthañcaiva tu saṃsmaret kuśapuṣpāṇi sarvāṇi sarvakarma samācaret udityañcitramantrañca haṃsaśuddhiṃ tato japet puṣpahastaṃ gṛhītvā tu ālayaṃ praviśedbudhaḥ gāvaśśivapurātpañca kṣitiṃ prāptāśśivecchayā nandā bhadrā ca surabhi suśīlā sumanāyataḥ nantādi sumanāntaṃ syādvarṇametatprakīrtitam gomātarasthitā bhūmau snānārthañca śivāya ca ṣaḍaṅgāni pavitrāṇi sarvasiddhikarāṇi hi gobhirvedāssamuttīkṣṇāssāṅgopāṅgapadakramāt śṛṅgāgre sarvatīrthāni sthāvarāṇi varāṇi ca

ācamyaṃ vidhivatkṛtvā sandhyākarma samācaret māhendraṃ snānamākhyātaṃ mārutaṃ snānakaṃ śṛṇu gogandhena samāviṣṭaṃ mūlamantraṃ japettataḥ mārutaṃ snānamākhyātaṃ mantrasnānamataḥ śṛṇu tāmrapātre jalaṃ gṛhya āpohiṣṭheti mantrataḥ anyakarmāṇi sarvāṇi pūrvavatkārayetsudhīḥ evaṃ pañcavidhasnānaṃ sarvakāryeṣu yogyatam arcanaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ ātmārthañca parārthakam pīṭhādyena samaṃ bandhaṃ jaṅgamaṃ liṅgamucyate svayaṃbhurohaṇañcaiva devamānuṣarākṣasam eṣu nityasthito devo vyaktāvyaktantu mānuṣam brahmaviṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivam vāmaṃ sadyamaghorañca tatpuruṣamīśānanāmakaḥ sarvadvayārodbhavañcaiva vāmādāpasamudbhavāḥ īśādākāśamutpanna ityete bhūtasaṃbhavāḥ āsanaṃ śuddhavidyāntaṃ mūrtiśaktyantagocaram sadāśivaṃ mantrasaṃbhūteraṣṭatriṃśatkalānvitam ayaṃ mantramiti khyātaśśivārcanamiti smṛtaḥ tṛtīyaṃ kuṭilākāraṃ caturthaṃ vahnisaṃbhavam śivamantramiti proktaṃ sarvayoni hṛdi sthitam etanyāsaṃ kṛtaṃ nityaṃ liṅgasya pariṇāmike kṣīrakṣastrantu pañcaite śivamantrasamarthitam tasyāssadāśivotpattissadāśiveśvara sthitiḥ viṣṇorbrahmā samutpanno brahmaṇo viśvasaṃbhavam śivaṃ śuddha iti prokto arūpī avyayīśvaraḥ

guhyādguhyataraṃ guhyaṃ svānubhūtyāvagamyate tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjayettu sadāśivam ātmārthañca parārthañca ādiśaivārhaṇaṃ bhavet tasmātsarvaprayatnena śivaliṅgārcanaṃ kuru tṛtīyaṃ dravyaśuddhiñca caturthaṃ liṅgaśodhanam pūrvoktavidhimārgeṇa dehaśuddhiṃ samācaret bhūmiṃ samatalaṃ kṛtvā sukhāsīna udaṅmukhaḥ daśa dikṣvastramantreṇa digvarecanamārabhet śivamantraṃ nyasedvidvān gandhapuṣpakuśairyutam karanyāsaṃ purā kṛtvā sṛṣṭimārgeṇa buddhimān kaniṣṭhādyaṅguṣṭhāntaṃ yatsaṃhāranyāsamucyate sthitinyāsamidaṃ proktaṃ sarvakarmasvayaṃ vidhiḥ īśādiṣṭavaṣṭavinyāsaṃ sadyā saṃhṛdiṃ nyaset hṛdayaṃ hṛdaye nyasya śiraḥ śirasi vinyaset astraṃ hastena vinyasya netraṃ netreṇa vinyaset pṛthivyādīni bījāni yojayettu viśeṣataḥ pītaṃ śuklaṃ tathā raktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dhūmrābhavarṇakam suvṛttañca pṛthivyādi maṇḍalāttu tathā kramāt trikoṇamagnidevañca vṛttañcendrasūryayoḥ hṛdayañca śiraścaiva śikhākavacameva ca pṛthivyādīni pañcāni pūjayettu viśeṣataḥ pañcodghātaścatastraśca trayaśca dvayamekaśaḥ nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyāśāntistathaiva ca jānunābhigale caiva lalāṭaṃ mūrdhnideśake tadbandhaṃ pañcagranthiṃ syāditi śāstrasya niścayaḥ

hlādayādīni mantreṇa pṛthivyādīni yojayet saṃhāramudrayā caiva śivatatve niyojayet kalebaraṃ dahetpaścādagdharajjuṃ vicintayet praṇavaṃ śvetakamalaṃ yogapīṭhamadhomukham tena ācitapiṇḍantu śarīrasthitikaṃ kuru akārādikṣakārāntaṃ varṇamantrakramaṃ nyaset i ī cakṣurdvaye caiva u ū oṣṭhadvayorapi e ai śrotradvaye caiva o au jihvāgale viduḥ kavargaṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve * * * * * * * * pavargaṃ dakṣiṇe haste yavargaṃ vāmahastake kālāśaktikalānyāsaṃ krameṇaiva tu yojayet mūrdhādi pādaparyantaṃ daśākṣarāṇi vinyaset karārcanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā paścāddehārcanaṃ kuru evaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa ātmaśuddhiṃ samācaret nāḍīmūlādadhaḥ padmaṃ turyāṅguli pramāṇataḥ bindunādasamāyuktaṃ śaktirityabhidhīyate tasya madhye tu pūrvajño vyaktāvyaktamiti smṛtāḥ krameṇaivordhvatatsarvaṃ sāttvikādiguṇairyutam hṛdaye yojanaṃ kuryānnābho homaṃ prakalpayet athavā ekakālantu saṃyajenmānasena tu samano manyāstu saṃyojya * * * * * * * ṣaḍādhārantu padmaṃ syādūrdhvādhaḥ kramayogataḥ haṃsādhāramidaṃ proktaṃ sarvasyāpi sadāśivaḥ evameva prakāreṇa cintayenmānasena tu mārjanālepanañcaiva vitānadhvajabhūṣitam

* * * * * * * * prāsādābhyantare bahiḥ āvāhayettato bhūmiṃ sarvābharaṇasaṃyutam galapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya svanādā deśikottamaḥ gandhataila * * * * * * * * * kaṃ tathā pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gandhapuṣpañca dhūpakam tāṃbūlamukhavāsañca nīrājanañca tarpaṇam sauvarṇarajataṃ tāmramathavā kāṃsyameva ca śaṅkhapatrādipātrāṇāṃ jaladroṇiñca vardhanam * * * tatra dravyāṇi śodhayettu tathaiva ca yathā krameṇa vinyasya pañcavaktrakramāgataḥ āghorasya kulānāntu aṣṭau vai śaktayaḥ kramāt nābhau pīṭhorasoścaiva aghorasya kalā nyaset kṛṣṇā mohā kṣudhā cintā grāmaṇī bhrāmiṇī tathā guhye guce gurvyośca jānvorjaṅghadvayorapi siddhiṃ riddhi dvitīlakṣmī medhākāntisvadhā praṇāḥ pādayorudvayoścaiva hastayorubhayostathā madhyame viṣṇubhāgaṃ syāttadūrdhve śivabhāgakam dvitīyaṃ jaṃbhabhāgañca tṛtīyaṃ marumeva ca īśabhāgaṃ nābhideśañca saptamaṃ udaraṃ viduḥ daśamaṃ kaṇṭhadeśaṃ syāccibukamekādaśaṃ smṛtam caturdaśa lalāṭaṃ syāt pañcadaśena mūrdhniṣu śaśinī ūrdhvamūrdhnistu aṅgadaṃ pūrvamūrdhniṣu jvālinīpañcamūrdhnistu praṇavenordhvavaktrakam nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyāśāntistu śeṣataḥ śipīkṛtena toyena prokṣayenmūlavidyayā

kaniṣṭhānāmikāmadhye puṣpān gṛhya vicakṣaṇaḥ visarjane tu tatkāle puṣpaṃ mūrdhni nidhāpayet avyaktānāntu liṃgānāṃ vyaktametat sucintayet sandhyākāle tu sā vyaktamavyaktañcānyakālake kāṣṭhena mardayetkāṣṭhaṃ prakriyāmatasaṃbhavam svabhāvataḥ śivaṃ proktaṃ kāṣṭhamadhye tu cāgnivat tāvatsadāśivaṃ proktaṃ śivalīlāpravartake tacchivaṃ pūjākāle tu kriyayoddhṛtya agnivat kuṃmākṛti śirākāramāmalasyākṛtiṃ vapuḥ tālaphalavadākāraṃ ārṣaṃ liṅgamucyate cūtañca mātulaṅgañca kadaṃbaphalamallikā svayaṃbhuvaruṣadevānāṃ trisūtramukulairvinā trisūtramakulairyuktaṃ mānuṣaṃ liṅgamucyate gaurīkalāstvahaṃ vakṣye gaurībījasamudbhavam hṛdayena ca bāhye'tra svaśane nābhideśake vāmadevakalāhyete devi dehe tu vinyaset śirolalāṭanetreṣu karṇayośca dvigaṇḍayoḥ jihvāyāṃ tālurandheṣu svarān ṣoḍaśakān nyaset ṭavargaṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve tavargaṃ vāmapādake makāraṃ kaṇṭhadeśe tu krameṇa paripaṭhyate asthimajjā śuklañca krameṇaiva tu vinyaset kṣakāraṃ meḍhradeśe tu vinyasettu viśeṣataḥ pṛthivyāpastathā jyoti vāyurākāśameva ca vākpāṇipādapāyurupasthañcaiva pañcamam rāgamāyā ca vidyāṃ ca kalāniyatireva ca

śuddhavidyāśuddhamayaṃ śuddhaṃ śivamiti smṛtam kalādhvāttvaṅgamityuktaṃ tatvāprāṇena meva ca bhuvanādhvā romakūpaṃ padādhvāsarameva ca pūrvavatsakalaṃ kṛtya śivamāvāhayettataḥ vibhūtiravyayaḥ śāstā pinākī tridaśādhipaḥ agnirudro hutāśaśca piṅgalaśca ghātako haraḥ ityeṣāmagnidigbhāge daśa devāḥ prakīrtitāḥ kartā bhoktā vidhātā cā dharttā dharmapatistathā nṛtirmaraṇo hantā krūradṛṣṭirbhayānakaḥ iti nai-ṛtadigbhāge daśa devāḥ prakīrtitāḥ jayabhadraśca divyahasto jīlādhipadameghanādakaḥ śīghro laghurvāyuvegasūkṣmakṣaṇakṣayāntakaḥ iti vāyavyadigbhāge daśa devāḥ prakīrtitāḥ lakṣmīdharo ratnadharaḥ śrīdharaśca prasādakaḥ vidyādhipaśca īśaśca tridaśassarva eva ca jyeṣṭhāśca bhūtapālaśca balapriyaśca eva ca brahmo vṛṣadharaścaiva anantakrodha eva ca phaṇīndro vajradaṃṣṭrīva ityadho diśi devatāḥ saṃvāhanaśca vivānaśca nabho vismṛti locanaḥ tadupari vīrabhadraṃ bhadrakālīdvayaṃ nyaset iti saptaśataṃ devamāvāhyantu vicakṣaṇaḥ hṛdayaṃ sarvamantreṇa kālāgni krūśmākau bhāgakaḥ brahmāṇḍamadhye bhuvanāni rudraḥ prakīrtitāḥ kṣakāre varṇa ityeṣāṃ bhuvanamaṣṭādhikaśatam nivṛttikālāya vyāptaṃ ṣaḍvidhādhvamiti smṛtam

gantorasantarūpañca śabdatanmātrapañcakam śrotrattvak cakṣujihvā ca ghrāṇabuddhīndriyaṃ matam guṇā prakṛtirityuktā caturviṃśattvameva ca śirasya vāmamantreṇa mantradvayamihocyate amareśaḥ prabhāseno naumīśaḥ puṣkaraḥ smṛtaḥ ityaṣṭakatatvānāṃ padaṃ tattvamanusmṛtam ityaṣṭakasaṃjñāyāṃ agnitatve prakīrtitāḥ vimaleśoṣṭabhāsañca mahendro hi maheśvaram cakradvaṇḍo dviraṇḍaśca mākoṭo maṇḍaleśvaraḥ ityevamaṣṭabhuvanaṃ aṃkāre tu sthitaṃ bhavet saumaṃ śailabrahmaṇañca ityaṣṭau buddhike sthitam kaumāra aumakañcaiva śrīkaṇṭhamiti kathyate ekaviṃśati padaṃ madhye maheśvaraparākramān ekarudrastrimūrtiśca śrīkhaṇḍaśca śikhaṇḍinaḥ sadāśivaṣaḍadhvātmā tasya prāṇaśiva smṛtaḥ kundendusphaṭikābhāsāṃ jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitam sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ daśadorbhissamanvitam pāśaṃ nāgāṅkuśañcaiva ghaṇṭāṃ vahniñca vāmake aghoramañjanaprakhyaṃ puruṣaṃ kuṅkumaprabham īśānaṃ kanakaṃ varṇaṃ vāmaṃ mukhamiti smṛtam divyagandhānuliptāṅgaṃ śāntarūpaṃ smitānanam vartamānasthitaṃ liṅgamāsīnantu śivādhikam samabhāgaṃ brahmaviṣṇuṃ śivabhāgādhikaṃ tathā ekattriṃśati bhāgena daśaiva brāhmavaiṣṇavam svāyaṃbhuvādi liṅgānāṃ samākāraṃ sthitaṃ bhavet

kuśamūlantu sthūlāgraṃ śayanantūpapadyate pīṭhe śaktiṃ samāvāhya tatra rū * * paṭhyate kumudaṃ kukṣirityāhuḥ bāhubhyāṃ kaṃpameva ca mahāpaṭṭimukhaṃ jñeyakṛtavārīśirastathā raktavarṇaṃ stribhaṅgāṅgī citravarṇena veṣṭitām nūpurā pādajālā ca udarabandhanasaṃyutam padmotpaladharāṃ devīṃ varadābhayapāṇinīm ṣaḍviṃśati kalāhyete gaurī dehe tu vinyaset vṛttapīṭhe sthito yogī gaurī āsanaṃ bhadrapīṭhake evaṃ dhyātvā tu mantrajñaḥ sarvapīṭhaviśeṣataḥ hastādhikapramāṇe tu sthitvā devaṃ prapūjayet ādhārasvamadhiṣṭhānaṃ ma pūrvaṃ maṇārhakam ādhāraṃ gudamityuktasvādhiṣṭhānantu liṅgakam puṣpeṣu gandhavat jñeyaṃ tileṣu tailavattathā ādhāramāsanaṃ proktamādheyaṃ paramāśśivam na śivena vinā śaktiḥ na hitaśśivaḥ śivaśaktistu saṃyogāt anyarūpasya codbhavam puṣpeṣu gandhavat jñeyaṃ tileṣu tailavattathā sadāśivagaurisaṃyogāt maheśo mahānicodbhavam maheśo bhavānisaṃyogādumārudrasamudbhavam brahmāsarasvati saṃyogāt ditī aditi saṃbhavam aditī ajasaṃyogāt ādityādi samudbhavam trayastriṃśaddevatā hyete svargalokādhivāsinaḥ ādityasaṃsṛtā kāle uṣādevi samudbhavam dānavā rakṣasaṃyogādrākṣaso yakṣisaṃbhavam

sraṣṭā pāśasya saṃyogāt pakṣijātastu saṃsmṛtā sarpo amṛtisaṃyogāt sarīsṛpavṛkṣasaṃbhavam evannaro mṛgañcaiva paśupakṣisarīsṛpam mahādavyaktasaṃjñātaṃ vyaktādākāśasaṃsmṛtā agnerāpasamudbhūtaṃ āpaḥ pṛthivī saṃsmṛtā tasya prāṇasya vihitaṃ ghaṭākāśamudīritam sarvaprāṇistu jananaṃ sarvaprāṇilayaṃ tathā liṅgāt prāpaṇodarśaṃ gaśabdāt gamanaṃ smṛtam liṅgānāmiti proktaṃ talliṅgaṃ pūjayetsadā tatvānāmāditattvantu śivatattvamiti smṛtam caturthamīśatattvantu śuddhavidyādipañcamam icchājñānakriyāśaktiḥ śivalīlā iti smṛtam sadāśivamiti khyātaṃ icchāśaktyostu janyate alpajñānaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ vidyātatvamiti smṛtam eyādyavaniparyantaṃ tatvalakṣaṇamucyate māyāyāḥ kālasaṃbhūtaṃ śuddhavidyāmiti smṛtam rāgādavyaktajananaṃ vyaktāt guṇasaṃsmatam sātvikaṃ rājasañcaiva tāmasaṃ kramatā smṛtam cetaso'haṅkārajaṃ nyastaṃ * ityabhidhīyate bhūtādikamahaṅkārā tanmātrapañcasaṃbhavam yathā jātamidaṃ sarvaṃ tathā layaṃ prakīrtitam sarveṣāmapi tattvānāṃ śivajanmaṃ tato layam tadeva vetanāvarga sadāśivasamāyutam ananteśādi vidyeśānīśatatvavinirgatam evameva prakāreṇa tatvānāmudbhavaṃ smṛtam

daṇḍādharāñca mudrāñca vāmahastañca kālakam kiñcittribhaṅgigaṅgāyāṃ vāmapādastu kuñjitam triṇetraṃ caturbhujañcaiva rudrabhāvasamanvitam kuṇḍalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ padmapīṭhopari sthitam nandīśaṃ raktavarṇaṃ syāt kalaṃ vaiṣṇavavarṇakam athavā'nyaprakāreṇa hastarūpañca vakṣyate paraśuṃ vāmahastantu dakṣiṇe veṇudaṇḍakam dvinetrau tribhujau caiva nandikālavadho punaḥ anantaṃ paśupatiñcaiva dakṣiṇadvārapālakau paśupatiṃ nīlavarṇastuṃ śaktihastogralocanāḥ sindhī dhure vā pāhaṃ khagahastogradaṃṣṭrakam vijayañcaiva bhṛṅgīśā uttaradvārapālakau bhṛṅgīśo bhṛṅgavarṇastu kṣurikāyudhahastayuk prāsādamaṇḍapadvāre dvāre caiva prakīrtitām saṃvṛttañca śriyāvṛttaṃ kuṇḍodaraṃ bṛhodaram śvetaśyāmanibhaṃ sarvaṃ khaḍgahastasamanvitam prakāragopurāhyeva caturdvāreṣu kalpitam abhayaṃ śūlahastañca dvinetraṃ śyāmavarṇakam prākāragopurāhyeva caturdvāreṣu kalpitam ūrdhvapādaṃ virūpākṣaṃ kalaṅkaṃ vakrapādakam mahāgopuradvāreṇa veṇudaṇḍadharā smṛtāḥ śyāmaṃ pītanibhañcaiva śūlāyudhañca tāśayuk paścimānālayadvāre sulabhaṃ sumukhaṃ nyaset sarveṣāṃ dvārapāle tu puṃstvantu prakalpayet dvārasthān prathamaṃ yaṣṭvā dvārapālā dvitīyakam

pañcamaṃ bhadrapīṭhantu ityevaṃ bahirāvṛtam tatra tatra viśeṣeṇa saptadevān samarpayet gaṅgāñca yamunāñcaiva śrīdevīñca sarasvatīm bhuvaṅgañca pataṅgañca yogadvayamihocyate vimalaṃ dakṣiṇe pūjya subāhuṃ vāmake yajet vṛṣādibalipīṭhāntaṃ parivāraṃ prapūjayet āgneyyāṃ durgaṃ saṃpūjya kātyāyanīti mantrataḥ svanāmādyakṣareṇaiva pūjayettu viśeṣataḥ vīrabhadrañca vighneśaṃ saptamātrañca pūjayet vāruṇe sukumārantu subrahmaṇyāya mantrataḥ saumye viṣṇuṃ samabhyarcya idaṃ viṣṇvīti mantrataḥ indrādilokapālāṃśca varṇavāhanacihnadhṛk astraṃ saṃpūjayettatra bālayauvanadevatān avighnaṃ vighnakartārau balipīṭhe tu pūjayet āgneyādīśaparyantaṃ svasvasthāne tu pūjayet indrādilokapālāṃśca pūjayettu viśeṣataḥ pitāmahonayormadhye asvaro gaṇa eva ca yāmye nai-ṛtayormadhye munīnāṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ uttaraiśānayormadhye rudraikādaśa pūjayet ekaprakāre sthānantu uktasthāne tu pūjayet balipīṭhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā caturdikṣu viśeṣataḥ abhyantare mṛtapīṭhaṃ bāhyapīṭhaṃ piśācakam gandharvāṇāntu saumye tu madhyamaṃ pūrvapaścime svanāmādyena mantreṇa oṅkārādi namostute astramantraṃ samuccārya paṭaṃ tatrā'pi nīya ca

dakṣiṇe jñānaśaktiṃ syāt kriyāśaktintu cottare garbhaṃgehaṃ tataḥ prāpya āsīno vā sthitastu vā śivamantraṃ nyasetpaścāt gandhapuṣpakuśairyutam catuṣkoṇaṃ mahāsiṃhamāsanaṃ pādanirmitam yogāsanaṃ daśāgrantu citravarṇaṃ suśobhanam catuṣpādaṃ mahāvṛttañcaturvedantu dhārakam evaṃ yogāsanaṃ proktaṃ āvāhayetsadāśivam āvāhanāsanaṃ yogaṃ snānaṃ vimalamāsane siṃhāsanaṃ dhyāyayenmantrī abhiṣekaṃ samācaret āḍhakaṃ pūritān gandhān krameṇa snāpayedbudhaḥ puṣṭacūrṇena cālipya dehaṃ mardayet punaḥ * * * gandhapuṣpaiśca apareṇa tu arcayet tribhāramuttamaṃ proktaṃ dvibhāraṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtam uśirañcandanañcaiva evañcaiva jayopitam snānānte vastramāveṣṭya ārdravastraṃ parityajet pañcabrahmaśivāṅgaiśca tryaṃbakaṃ viṣṇusūktakam ṣaṭsūktavaruṇañcaiva tvaritarudramataḥ param daśākṣareṇa mantreṇa hṛdayenaiva vinyaset śaktibījāṅkuranālaṃ paścāddharmādi vinyaset vairāgyaṃ pītabhūtasyādaiśvaryaṃ sitavāriṇā gulakā caturyugā caiva puruṣā na napuṃsakā aiśānye tu śiroyugmaṃ pādayugmantu nai-ṛte tasyopari nyasedetā naṣṭau vidyeśvarān kramāt īśānaṃ dikṣu koṇeṣu ekarudrādi vinyaset padmanābhaṃ janābhañca vidyeśānāntu varṇakam

varadābhayahastañca kṛṣṇaṃ paraśudhāriṇam anantāsanerccayedevaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt ūrdhve dalāṣṭakopeta kesaraiśca samāyutam vāmājyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca paścimottaradakṣiṇe balavikaraṇintu nai-ṛtyāṃ balapramathinīñca vāyave atasīkusamaprakhyā tu dvinetrī dhāraṇī tathā balavikaraṇī kṛṣṇā paraśuhastattriṇetriṇī sarvabhūtadamanī devī gadāhastā sugāṃbarī evaṃ dhyātvā vidhānena gandhapuṣpādinārcayet aghoraṃ dalasaṅkīrṇaṃ puruṣaṃ karṇikā bhavet evaṃ padmāsanaṃ proktaṃ paścādvāmenācamanaṃ dadet gandhaṃ dadyāstu vāmena puṣpamīśānamantrakam śikhāmantreṇa dātavyaṃ hāraṃ hṛdayamantrataḥ svarṇatoraṇa svarṇapatraṃ patracchedaphalānvitam dukūlavargadevāṅgaiḥ kaṃbalaṃ pañcavarṇakam dhūpaṃ dadyādyathā nyāyyaṃ krameṇaiva viśeṣataḥ karpūraṃ kastūrikāñcaiva madhusarpigulairyutam liṅgapīṭhaṃ viśeṣeṇa candanā lepayeddhṛdā tadūrdhve vastramābharaṇaṃ paścāddhūpaṃ pradāpayet dhūpaṃ pūrveṇa dātavyaṃ ghaṇṭānādasamanvitam dakṣiṇe dhūpamādāya kapitthaṃ hastasaṃyutam puṣpaṃ hastena saṃgṛhya padākāvakrasaṃyutam dīpaṃ dadyāttadante tu ghaṇṭānāda samanvitam puṣpāñjaliḥ tataḥ kṛtvā surabhimudrāṃ pradarśayet mukhavāsaṃ samāyuktaṃ bhasmaṃ dadyātpañcamūlasu

paristareṇa darbhāṇāṃ paridhitrayameva ca brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe'bhyarcya uttare tu janārdanam praṇītāpātramādāya janārdanaṃ pūjayetkramāt homānte tu baliṃ kuryāt mekhalopari vinyaset bahirbalividhiṃ kuryāt antarbalimathācaret prathamamaṣṭanāgañca dvitīyaṃ dvādaśādikam agnimantramanusmṛtya svāheti iti yojayet āhūya pādyakaṃ paścāt ācāryaśśiṣya eva ca prathamamantarbaliṃ kuryāt dvitīyaṃ dinadevatā umāskandeśvaraṃ devaṃ grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ tathā śaṅkhaghoṣasamāyuktaṃ brahmaghoṣasamanvitam chatrantu cāmarau caiva vyajanaṃ dhvajameva ca sarvabhaktajanānāntu nṛpatīn brahmameva ca madhyamaṃ rudrakanyāyāṃ gāndharvantu śivāgrake pādyācamanaṃ cārghya dhūpadīpasamanvitam darpaṇañcāmarañcaiva vyajanaṃ chatrameva ca nālikerasamāyuktaṃ panasaṃ kadalīphalam taddinantu samārabhya yajñaṃ saptadinaṃ bhavet āsthānamaṇṭapaṃ kuryāt gomayālepane śubhe tanmadhye tailasaṃsthāpya pūrvākṣatasamanvitam dūrvākṣatasamāyuktaṃ mūrdhni nikṣepayedbudhaḥ snapanaṃ kārayitvā tu pañcāśatpañcaviṃśatiḥ muktābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ śvetacandanalepitam śuddhavastraparīdhānaṃ śvetamālyavibhūṣitam bahunaivedyasaṃyuktaṃ upadaṃśasamanvitam

ityevaṃ lakṣaṇairyuktā nārī puṃsā vivarjayet abhiniryāya saṃyuktaṃ tālavindālasaṃyutam etallakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ gāndharvaṃ samudāhṛtam taddoṣasamanārthāya snapanaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ śuddhanṛttādinā pūrvaṃ niśāyāmadhivāsayet śayanaṃ kalpayettatra ajātīni ca kalpayet śāyayetkautukaṃ badhvā svarṇasūtrantu sūtrayet maunako vādyakañcaiva niśāyāmadhivāsayet tadardhe sthaṇḍilaiścaiva tadardhaiśca tilairapi sa kūrcān sapidhānāṃśca sa vastraiḥpallavairyutam prātaḥkāle samuddhṛtya śaucācamanapūrvakam navabhiḥ kalaśaisthāpya dīkṣāmantramanusmaran hṛdayena tu mantreṇa puṣpaṃ śirasi vinyaset tannāmaṃ vācayennityaṃ rudranārī yathākramam vighneśañca namaskṛtvā phalapuṣpahavirdadet gandhapuṣpahavirdatvā tāṃbūlañca pradāpayet tataḥ prakaranārīṇāṃ praviśenmaṇṭapaṃ prati sāyaṃkāle baliṃ dadyāt maṇṭapasyādhidevatā tanmadhye mukhaṃ sthāpya gandhapuṣpādinā'rcayet nandikeśvaramabhyarcya gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt tṛtīyaṃ vaṃśatālākhyaṃ oṅkāragaṇamudāhṛtam ṣaṣṭhakaṃ vādyakairyuktaṃ saptamaṃ puṣpamokṣamam daśamaṃ nṛttasaṃpūrṇaṃ ityete nṛttalakṣaṇam devasyottare deśe nṛttasya sukhamāsthitau nardako mardakaiścaiva dakṣiṇena tu saṃsthitau

* * * * * * * ṇāṃ paridhitrayameva ca samidhā sadyamantreṇa ājyaṃ vā'nena mantrakaiḥ tilamīśānamantreṇa sarṣapaṃ kavacena tu pāyasaṃ gulakhaṇḍañca śivamantreṇa hūyate tryaṃbakena mantreṇa kautukantu naṭeśvaram kautukaṃ astradevānāṃ mṛgaṃ vādyantu kautukam sumuhūrte viśeṣeṇa bandhayetkautukaṃ hṛdā nṛttagītañca vādyantu purāṇaṃ kathitaṃ kramāt nivedayettato mantrī tāṃbūlantu nivedayet chatrañca cāmarañcaiva darpaṇaṃ darśayetkramāt navavastrairalaṅkṛtya kautukaṃ pūrvavatkramāt śvetapuṣpairalaṅkṛtya śvetacandanalepitam sthaṇḍilaprabhasaṃyuktaṃ biṃbaprabhasamanvitam dhūpadīpasamāyuktaṃ nīrājanaṃ viśeṣataḥ nṛpatī bhaktajanānāntu śeṣabhasmantu dāpayet ācāryasnānamevantu pratisnānaṃ samācaret devāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kuryādaṣṭadroṇaiśca śālibhiḥ sthālikā taṇḍulaiḥ pūrya kṛṣṇagandhasamanvitam śaṅkhaṃ dundubhinirghoṣaiḥ stotramaṅgalavācakaiḥ devasannidhisaṃprāpte homaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ puṇyāhaṃ vācayeddhīmān homaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ homānte kṛṣṇagandhaṃ syāt lepayettu naṭeśvaram brāhmaṇān bhojayettatra svasvasūtra samanvitam mūlaberasugandhaṃ syāt parivārasamanvitam caturvedaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā bhūsurān bhojayetkramāt

geyantu darśanaṃ prāpya kanyādarśanakaṃ bhavet gandhadvāreti mantreṇa tāḍayettu viśeṣataḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ namaskṛtvā vādyakān tāḍayetkramāt nandimantrasamuccārya mṛdavādyantu tāḍayet jhallarīmukhañcaiva paṭahaṃ mardalaṃ tathā evaṃ saptavidhaṃ kuryāt mahānāṭyaṃ tathaiva ca dhūpadīpasamāyuktaṃ nīrājanaṃ viśeṣataḥ chatrañca cāmarau caiva vyajanantu kramātsudhīḥ sarvabhaktajanānāntu sarveṣāṃ gandhameva ca mahāhavirnivedyasyāttāṃbūlantu nivedayet sarvapuṣpairalaṅkṛtya sarvayoṣasamanvitam puṣpaprabhasamāyuktaṃ citraprabhasamanvitam saptagṛhaṃ tataḥ kuryāt praviśyāsthānamaṇṭapam nīrājanaṃ tataḥ kuryāt bhasmantu dāpayetkramāt tāṃbūlaṃ dāpayitvā tu darpaṇaṃ darśayetkramāt snapanaṃ kārayitvā tu paścācca pañcaviṃśatiḥ tālacūrṇaṃ sakṛccūrṇaṃ udakaṃ grāhya buddhimān puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra vedadhvani samanvitam śvetacandanasaṃyuktaṃ karpūrameva miśritam havirnivedayeddhīmān tāṃbūlaṃ tatra kārayet śivāgre maṇṭapaṃ kuryāt viśedāsthānamaṇṭapam paiśācanṛttasaṃyuktaṃ mahānāṭakasaṃyutam sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvamālyavibhūṣitam grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt praviśetālakaṃ kuru? ārātrikasamāyuktaṃ bhasmaṃ datvā viśeṣataḥ

śeṣabhasmaṃ tataḥ kuryāt bhūpatiśca viśeṣataḥ nālikerasamāyuktaṃ panasaṃ kadalīphalam mṛgayātrāṃ samārabhya pūrvarātrādhivāsayet vājiyajñāstadante tu gaccha yatra gajastathā kecit khaḍgadharāścaiva kecitparaśuddharastathā yuddhārambhe tathāssarve śīghraṃ gacchetsamākulam sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ vanayātrasamanvitam gaurīcaṇḍeśanandīśo mahākālo vṛṣastathā pradoṣakālasamaye tīrthādhivāsanaṃ tathā taṃ madhye lalitaṃ kuryāt tripādī tatra vinyaset umāskandeśvaraścaiva mantradevasamanvitam kautukaṃ bandhayeddhīmān umāskandeśvaraṃ tathā tryaṃbakena mantreṇa rakṣāsūtraṃ subandhayet nadītaṭākamudreṇa astratīrthasamanvitam sthaṇḍilaṃ tatra kurvīta sthāpayennavakuṃbhakān saptatālavidhaṃ kuryādācāryaśśiṣyasaṃyutam grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt praviśedālayaṃ prati prātaḥkāle samārabhya avabhṛthasnānamuttamam grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryādumāskandeśvaraṃ tathā cūrṇotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryānmaṇṭapāgraviśeṣataḥ tanmadhye sthaṇḍilaṃ kuryāllūkhalaṃ musalena tu vastradūrvāsamāyuktaṃ darbhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ paristaret rudrakanyāsamāyuktaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ dhūpadīpasamāyuktaṃ puṣpahaste pradāpayet śaṅkhaghoṣasamāyuktaṃ sarvavādyasamanvitam

tailadūrvākṣatān puṣpaiḥ kūrcamantraiva vinyaset puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra ghṛtaśīrorpaṇaṃ tathā umāskandeśvarañcaiva astrabherīntu tailakam dhūpadīpasamāyuktamārātrikasamanvitam darpaṇaṃ darśayetkṛtvā cāmaraṃ vyajanaṃ tathā pratimāmastradevānāṃ rajanīcūrṇamastakam tailalastraṃ cūrṇapātraṃ astradeva samanvitam prākāre tu pradakṣiṇyāṃ śīghraṃ gacchetsamākulam yakovādyanṛttaṃ vā gaṇikābhissamanvitam paristareṇa bhājānāmarcayetkalaśannava saptatālavidhaṃ proktaṃ ācāryaśśiṣya eva vā grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt praviśedālayaṃ tataḥ yāge saṃpūjayettatra pūrṇāhutimathācaret grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryācchivāgre maṇṭapaṃ tathā vāgīśvarasya devānāmapi bāhye pradakṣiṇam umāskandeśvarañcaiva snapanaṃ tatra kārayet devāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā aṣṭadroṇaiśca śālibhiḥ śuddhavastraparīdhānaṃ śvetamālāvibhūṣitam dhūpadīpau samāropya nīrājanaṃ viśeṣataḥ lājapuṣpaṃ gṛhītvā tu brāhmaṇāṃ svastivācakaiḥ yāgopacāraṃ saṅgṛhya vastrahemāṅgulīyakaiḥ dhvajadevaṃ samabhyarcya mudgānnantu nivedayet bherīghoṣasamāyuktaṃ sarvālaṅkārameva ca caṇḍeśasthānasaṃyuktaṃ vastrairābharaṇairyutam homānte tu nivedyaṃ syāt tāṃbūlantu nivedayet

annaliṅgasamāyuktaṃ balipātrasamanvitam maunavratadharāssarve sandhidevān visarjayet grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryānmahāpīṭhe baliṃ kṣipet gaurīyāgamahaṃ vakṣye pūrvarātrādhivāsayet grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt bhaktotsavamanantaret sarvadāridryanāśa syāt rājño vijayavarddhanam utsavasya viśeṣeṇa prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate dhvajasya dhvajadaṇḍasya paṭasya tu viśeṣataḥ hṛdayena śataṃ hutvā snāpanaṃ pañcagavyakaiḥ homadravyavihīne tu hṛdayena śatāhutiḥ hṛnmantreṇa śataṃ hutvā sarvaśāntinimittataḥ śūlasya patanañcaiva sarveṣāñca śatāhutiḥ kṛtvā tu snapanaṃ tatra mūlamantreṇa hūyate tithivāramuhūrte ca kālāpekṣāṃ na kārayet pratidikkarma sarveṣāṃ pūrvavatkārayedbudhaḥ kalahe rudhirasrāve agnidaṇḍe tathaiva ca sūtikāmṛtasaṃsparśe darśane tu viśeṣataḥ śāntihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pañcagavyena prokṣayet pūrvavattu dhvajārohaṃ punarutsavamācaret patitairvyādhipīḍyāṃśca mūlādirudhirasravam puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra asya nārīkriyā bhavet punarvādyaṃ samāropya pavamānaṃ samuccaran sarvalokahitārthāya sarvaprāṇihitāvaham svasthāpanapratiṣṭhā ca pratiṣṭhāpañcabhedakaḥ sautaṃ sthāpanasiddhiñca jīrṇoddhāraṃ susaṃsthitam

śailajaṃ lohajaṃ vā'pi saudhajaṃ ratnajaṃ tathā śilā parīkṣitāñcaiva savyaṃ vai strīśilā budhaḥ dinavāramuhūrtañca kuryādvai śilpibhissaha rudrastrīnavamāsañca madhukṣīrantu darśanam ṛṣidakṣiṇapārśvena madhyāhne tu prakāśayet śaṅkhadundubhi nirghoṣaiḥ muhūrtantu vicakṣaṇaḥ digvidikṣu baliṃ kuryādācāryaśśilpibhissaha lohaje tu madhūcchiṣṭaṃ saṅgrahe tu vicakṣaṇaḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśamathaikaikaṃ tattadbhāgena copari tathaiva mānahīnaṃ vā tanmānaṃ vā gṛhe punaḥ udayañcaturāśīti dviṣaṣṭhī ca tathaiva ca evamādyodayaṃ kuryāttena mānāṅgulena tu guṇena guṇitaṃ yatra dusvaive vasubhiḥ kramāt hrasvairdve saptaviṃśena śeṣamaśvādigaṃ bhavet śeṣakarmādi vā syādvai tenaiva vasubhirguṇaiḥ navena guṇitaṃ yatra taddaśāṃśakramādbudhaḥ nandāṃśakena yatkāryaṃ śeṣāṃśamaṃśakaṃ viduḥ yoniṣkadhvajasiṃhākhyo gajo vṛṣendragodhanaḥ vāreṣu sitavitsoma guravaśca śubhāvahām aṃśeṣu tattadīśena uktā śaktistathaiva ca śeṣāśca śubhamākhyātā eteṣāṃ śubhadaṃ param grāmaścāśānakūlāṃśca saṃgrahe tu vicakṣaṇaḥ janmasaṃpadvipatkṣema pratyaraṃ sādhako vadhaḥ vipatpratyaranaidhañca tathā candrāṣṭamaṃ bhavet arthottarantu saṅgrāhya aśubhaṃ * * * matam

mūlaliṅganirūpeṇa procyate sakalantviha daivikaṃ liṅgamānena kṛtvā vai biṃbamākṛtiḥ avyaktaṃ bindurūpaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ śaktimārabhet mahāmoṭīñca durgāñca saptamātṛgaṇāstathā evaṃ lakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ śaktirūpaṃ vidhīyate padmanīlotpalaṃ hastamabhayaṃ varadānvitam evaṃ devi samākhyātaṃ viśeṣamadhunā śṛṇu kamaṇḍalvakṣahastena abhayaṃ varadānvitam prabhāhīnaṃ prabhāyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam caturbhujaṃ triṇetrañca mṛgaṭaṅkasamanvitam vāmahastasamāyuktaṃ ṭaṅkaṃ paridhi kiṅkiṇī abhayaṃ varadaṃ pūrvaṃ parahastasamanvitam paridhāya vācakā hyete kāmakoṣṭhamiti smṛtam aṣṭadikṣvantarālantu harmyāgre tu viśeṣataḥ vāme vā dakṣiṇe vā'pi sthāpanīyaṃ manonmanī dvādaśa staṃbhasaṃyuktaṃ maṇṭapantu tridhā bhavet ratnanyāsaṃ tathā pūrve dvitīyaṃ nayanamokṣaṇam pañcamantu jale vāsaṃ ṣaṣṭhamaṃ maṇṭapa * * navamaṃ nārghyavinyāsaṃ daśamaṃ sthāpanaṃ param aiśe vā pāvake vā'tha aindre vā somameva vā pratiṣṭhāmaṇṭapaṃ kuryāt kārayettu viśeṣataḥ pañcaviṃśatihastairvā daśapañca kare'pi vā * * * gulamutsedhaṃ tālaṃ tatraiva kārayet dvihastaṃ vedivistāraṃ dvihastantu catuṣkaram yonikuṇḍaṃ caturdikṣuṃ vidikṣu padmakuṇḍakam

navāgniṃ kalpayeddhīmān ekapañcāgnikārayet gomayenānulipyātra maṇṭapaṃ kuṇḍavedikā brāhmaṇān bhojayettatra punargomayavāriṇā punaḥ puṇyāhamārabhya vāstuhomaṃ samārabhet sthāpanasya dinātpūrve aṅkurāṇyarpayedbudhaḥ sadyāṅkuraṃ tathā caiva sadyādhivāsanaṃ kuru ekāhe vā tathā caiva ratnanyāsaṃ tathā bhavet gomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā sthaṇḍilaṃ vidhinā kuru pūjayettasya madhye tu tato'nantāsanaṃ tathā māṇikkamadhyamaṃ kuryāt indranīlasya meva ca nīlaṃ vai yāmyadigbhāge gometakaṃ nir-ṛtī tathā vajraṃ tatsaumyadigbhāge pravālaṃ śāṅkare diśi sthāpayetpratimantrasya snigdhaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ tathā arcayuktadinātpūrvaṃ * * parakramā viduḥ tasmāttu phaṇayettatra netra yugmadine kṛte tanmadhye beramādāya sthāpayeddhṛdayena tu hemaprabhaprahāreṇa lepayedṛṣṭimaṇḍale vartayettatkrameṇaiva rajataṃ saptamakramāt śilpinantu visṛjyātra puṇyāhaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ madhughṛtaṃ payaścaiva pratiprasthantu pātrake sthaṇḍilaṃ pūrvavatpūrve beraṃ tasyopari nyaset pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyai praṇavena tu buddhimān na yajennetra mantreṇa netramunmīlanaṃ kuru tasmājjāgrādipañcaite vartate divyajāgrakam pañcagavyābhiṣekantu śrīpatraṃ kuśāyā saha

darśayeddhenumudrāñca netramantramanusmaran svarṇapuṣpakrameṇaiva ghṛtaṃ tatraiva vinyaset godhenu havyamantreṇa savatsāṅgaṃ pradarśayet pracchannapaṭamājyā te taddravyādyādinibhaissuraiḥ dhānyañca brīhisaṃyuktamudgamāṣakulaṃ tathā jalatīre tu saṃsthāpya jalenaivābhiṣecayet vāmādiśaktayaścāṣṭairvardhanīṃ vinyasedbudhaḥ rātrau yatyantake caiva jananī vā rathe sthitam snānamaṇṭapamāveśya vedikā tasya copari pañcamṛtpañcagavyaiśca bilvapatraiśca varṣayet nama kuṃbhābhiṣekānte vastreṇa sevyamantravit kautukaṃ bandhayeddhīmān brahmaghoṣasamākule pūrvoktena vidhānena maṇṭapaṃ pūjayetkramāt caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ catustoraṇa bhūṣitam sthaṇḍilaṃ pūrvavatkuryādaṣṭadroṇaiśca śālibhiḥ dārupañcabhujañcaiva romajaṃ pakṣipiñcchajam dārujaṃ phalakā caiva mukulaṃ kevalaṃ tathā dāruśca pariveṣaśca kalpayecchayanaṃ tathā devīmāsanamārabhyacchādayecchayanopari sadyādhivāsanaṃ tatra pratimaṃ yānikaṃ tathā pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ ācāryaṃ putrakaissaha gandhādīnarcayetsarvān tatra devīṃ svanāmataḥ surabhirdarśayedvidvān tathottarābhimukhe sthitaḥ antardhyānena vedīśamudbhistaṃ pratimārabhet praṇavādi namontāśca yojayettadanukramāt

sthāpanaṃ caiva sānnidhya sannirodhaṃ tathaiva ca brahmāṅgaṃ vinyasetpaścāt digvidikṣu kramādbudhaḥ manoraṃbhaṃ namaskāradarśayettu viśeṣataḥ aṅgairaṅgāni vinyasya pūjayettu yathāvidhiḥ tato mantraṃ nyaseccaiva gandhādīnāmarcayet tato homaṃ prakurvīta tasya tatkramamucyate adhidevā nyaseccaiva pūrvādīni pradakṣiṇam agnyādhānādikaṃ sarvamagnikāryoktamācaret samidhājyānnalājaiśca sarṣapāṃśca yavān tilān apāmārgārkajañcaiva khadiraṃ pāvakādiṣu tamutparyāyasarveṣu alābhe tu palāśakaiḥ caruṃ vai ghoramantreṇa lājaṃ vāmena hūyate śirasā ca talaṃ hutvā pratyekaṃ vividhāṣṭakam dravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ hutvā sparśayedberavardhanī sarvadravyāhuti dravyā tattatkuṇḍāni mūrtinām madhukṣīraśataṃ śarkarādīn śataṃ hunet ṛgyajussāmavedāśca atharvaṃ vedādhyayanaṃ kuru bhavetkuryādviśeṣeṇa tāṃbūlantu nivedayet sadyādhivāsanañcaiva dikkāle viśeṣataḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa nityakarma samācaret sumuhūrte sulagne ca devīmabhyarcayettataḥ saddravyāhutiṃ hutvā tattanmūrtyāhutiṃ śatam jayādirabhyādhānañca rāṣṭrabhṛcchakramāddhunet mūrtimān sādhayetpaścāt paridhīñca paristaret nikṣipedagnimadhye tu tadotthāya tu deśikaḥ

sarvapatrakarairyukta śuklamālyairalaṅkṛtam savastrakūrcān sarvatra varjayettu viśeṣataḥ snānamaṇṭapamadhyantu pīḍhe biṃbaṃ nivedayet pañcakṛt pañcagavyaiśca jñātvā devīstryaṃbakam gandhodakodanaṃ sthānaṃ haridrāmalakaissaha śilpiṃ visarjayettatra pañcagavyābhiṣecayet śuddhodakena beraiścābhiṣekaṃ tatra kārayet arghyaṃ datvā viśeṣeṇa puṣpaṃ mūrdhni ca dāpayet biṃbāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayet pūrvavatkramāt varṇairbrahmāṅgamantraistu vidyāmūrtiviśetpunaḥ dhyāyedaścindumantrasya hṛdi madhye samāhitam ghaṭe ghaṭesmitanmantraṃ jayaprāṇastu nirmitam uttare vardhanītoyaṃ tanmātreṇa tu deśikaḥ pratimā hṛdaye nyastvā tataḥ kuṃbhābhiṣecayet saṃvatsarākṣaraṃ vā'pi dakṣiṇe paścimena vā tena toyena devīṃ syādabhiṣekaṃ samācaret * * * * * * * va praṇavaṃ mūrdhni vinyaset gandhādīn pūjayetpaścādviśeṣādhyaṃ tataḥ punaḥ vastrābharaṇamālā ca dhūpadīpaṃ dadetpunaḥ evamādīni sarvāṇi hṛdayena pradāpayet śailajaṃ prathamaṃ sthitvā lohajañca calācalam tatrādau kautukañcaiva utsavaṃ punarācaret śayane śayanoktena śeṣā sarvamayaṃ viduḥ śailajā iti mūlena vinyasennavaratnakā toyādhivāsanaṃ tatra tatopaśayanaṃ vinā

saudhajaṃ bhitticitreṇa pādāgre hastamātrakau karmārcarūpamevoktaṃ tatraiva sarvamācaret gaurīmimāya mantreṇa homakarmādikaṃ japet mukulaṃ padmamudrāñca bījamudrāṃ pradarśayet gaurīkalākṣastvahaṃ vakṣye gaurībījasamudbhavā mṛtyuśrā * * * * rāmedhvasvastiśca varmaṇaḥ śāntibhṛtikriyā kṣāntighorā vāmakalā nyaset ṣaḍviṃśatikabāhye tu gaurīdehe tu vinyaset hṛdaye ca gale bāhyoḥ jaṭhare nābhideśake ūrdhvorjānudvayoścaiva pṛṣṭhadvayośca pārśvake pādayorubhayoścaiva hastayorubhayorapi daṇḍamūle tu saṃyojya navavastrasamāyutam sūryāstame tu kartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ śaṅkhadundubhiḥ kṛttikāṃbhaṃ prakartavyaṃ pradhānaṃ kṛttikāṃ bhavet dīpayantravidhānena mahādīpaṃ prakalpayet * * * * * * * * dviprasthaṃ balipātrakaiḥ grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā baliṃ pūrvādivinyaset ācāryaṃ pūjayettatra vastrahomāṅgulīyakaiḥ prabhūtahaviṣaṃ datvā upadaṃśasamanvitam pavitraṃ nāma yatproktaṃ śuddhamityabhidhīyate sarve ṛṣigaṇāścaiva kṣetrasamudgaṇāḥ āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe vā'pi kuryādbhādrapade'pi vā bhādrapadādhamaṃ jñeyaṃ tribhirmāsaiḥ prakīrtitam athavā tu trayodaśyāṃ tato gandha pavitrakam adhamaṃ tāmrasūtrantu alābhe kārpāsameva ca

netrapaṭodbhavañcaiva padmasūtrantu cottamam brāhmaṇakṣatriyo vaiśyā śūdrakanyāya sūtravit śoddhodakena saṃprokṣya kṣālayettu yathāvidhiḥ pālikān pūrṇakuṃbhañca darpaṇañca vicitrayet dvādaśaṃ ṣoḍaśañcaiva pañcaviṃśatireva vā snapanadravyasahitaṃ sthāpayedvidhipūrvakam pūrvoktavidhinā caiva kalaśasthāpanaṃ caret samidājyacaruṃ lājān sarṣapāścāthavā tilān samidājyakrameṇaiva ājyaṃ vāmena hūyate īśānaṃ sarvadravyāṇi ājyāni hṛdayena tu kavacena mayaṃ hutvā apūpairastrameva ca pūrṇāntu mūlamantreṇa evaṃ homaprakalpayet ṣoḍaśapratimañcaiva gandhapuṣpādirarcayet mahānaivedyakaṃ paścāttāṃbūlantu nivedayet śaṅkhabheryādighoṣaiśca jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ nidrābhaṅgaṃ niśā kuryāt samādhikṛta yogataḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ kuryāt pañcāśatpañcaviṃśatiḥ maṅgalārthantu prakartavyaṃ pañcaviṃśatpavitrakam bandhanaṃ tatra kurvīta tantunā bandhayetkramāt granthibandhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā gandhapatrantu kallolaṃ eṣāṃ granthiṃ vidhīyate liṅganāhapramāṇaṃ yat tatpramāṇena bandhayet hemarājatapātrañca tāmrakāṃsyamathāpi vā tanmadhye tu nidhātavyaṃ gandhapuṣpādinārcayet tasyopari nyasetkūrcaṃ sthāpayenmaṇṭape kramāt

śaucācamanaṃ snānaṃ sandhyāvandanameva vā īśvarārohaṇaṃ sūtrañcaṇḍeśāya nivedayet puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu svastimaṅgalavācakai bherīmṛdaṅgapaṭalaiḥ kāhalaiḥ kāṃsyaghaṇṭakaiḥ śaṅkhadundubhivādyaiśca sarvālaṅkāraśobhitam svarṇapuṣpaśiroyuktaṃ svarṇayajñopavītinam sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ puṣpamālāsuśobhitam sādhakānāmalaṅkṛtya pavitramuddharetkramāt tato garbhagṛhaṃ gatvā āropayetpavitrakam nirgatañcaiva taṃ gehamālayaṃ sūtraveṣṭanam ācāryāḥ pūjayettatra yayā vittānusārataḥ paricārakapūjaiśca brāhmaṇān bhojayettataḥ āgamantu samārabhya śivadharmapurāṇakaiḥ sarvadevān samāropya parādīnapavitrakaiḥ janān sarvān pradātavyaṃ karṇikān sa pavitrakam pavitrārohaṇaṃ tatra sandhyākāle tu pūjayet sa dāro'haṃ tataḥ kuryāt sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutam snapanaṃ tatra kurvīta gandhapuṣpādinārcayet kaupīnamuttaraṃ saṅgaṃ yogināntu pradāpayet sūcikarmādirātriñca dineṣveteṣu varjayet padmamaṇḍalamevaṃ vā ardhacandramathāpi vā maṇḍalaṃ pūjayettatra pūjāvasānakālake darpaṇañcāmarañcaiva tālavṛntañca citrakā ābharaṇaṃ pātraṃ bhasmadhāraṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ pavitrakam añjanaiva ca pātreṇa añjanantu śalākayoḥ

śuktipātraṃ pañcalohaṃ aṣṭamaṅgalamāyudham kṛṣṇamṛgañca paraśuṃ bhikṣāpātramadhaskṛtam gaṅgākeyūramālāśca aṣṭanāgavidhairapi lalāṭamālā kaṇṭamālā karṇantu nālabandhakāḥ japamālā bāhumālā korparairhastamālayā evameva krameṇaiva dravyaprati ca sthāpayet evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyassa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt deviyuktaṃ yathā śāstraṃ śāstraṃ pavitrārohaṇam maṇṭapantu caturbhāga mekabhāgantu vedikā pañcatālapramāṇena madhye maṇḍalamālikhet padmapīṭhe samālikhya śvetaraktañca kṛṣṇakam padmapīṭhasya bāhye tu śvetavidhiṃ prakalpayet pītañcaiva tathā nyāyaṃ caturdvārāṇi kalpayet kapolo kapolakaṃ kuryāt brahmasthānādvahiṣviha tryaṅgulaṃ padmamevaṃ syāt tryaṅgulantu svastikam śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śyāmaṃ tathā nyaset śālipiṣṭena śvetañca sindhūraṃ raktadhātukam dagdhalī * ca kṛṣṇaṃ syāt pādaṃ pratikṛtaṃ kṛti evantu sarvato bhadraṃ latāliṅgodbhavaṃ śṛṇu daloṣṭau pañcavarṇena lekhayettu viśeṣataḥ vyomena karṇikāṃ kuryāt pakṣāṃśenaiva kesaram padmabāhyaṃśakārdhe tu śvetavarṇena vīthikam tatsamāne kapolantu śobhātulyopaśobhikām kṛṣṇacūrṇamiti proktaṃ kapolāttu viśeṣataḥ saptapadaṃ liṅgaṃ kṛtvā catuṣpadaṃ bāhyapīṭhakam

indrādisomaparyantamaṣṭāviṃśatpadaṃ bhavet pītavarṇaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ śvetanīlaṃ prakalpayet koṇakoṇe caturthantu viparītañca pūrṇayet ācāryamanobhavaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣvekāgramānasaḥ prāgagradeśasūtrantu udagagraṃ tathaiva ca caturdikṣu navabhāgaṃ syāt prāsādaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ aṣṭabhāgaṃ samaṃ kṛtvā prāsādaṃ pūrvavatprati liṅgapīṭhasamāyuktaṃ pādavargāttribhāgagam pañcacūrṇaṃ pañcamukhaṃ puruṣādi viśaṣataḥ vāmādiśaktayaścāṣṭau paritaḥ parivinyaset ṣaṣṭhyādhikañca triśataiḥ parito maṇḍalaṃ likhet kadalīphalamāmraphalaṃ panasaṃ khaṇḍaśaḥ karā niṣkaṃ vā'pi tadardhaṃ vā tadardhārdhamathāpi vā śataniṣkādi ekāntaṃ yathālābhe tu parvatam vācake rajatādristu dakṣiṇe tāmraparvatam * * * * * * sthāpya vāyau lavaṇaparvatam evamuktāni sarvāṇi pratyekaṃ bhārameva vā pañcabrahmaṣaḍaṅgaiśca jayādīn homayedbudhaḥ maṇḍalecottare bhāge sthaṇḍilaṃ śālibhiḥ kuru netrabandhaṃ tataḥ kuryāt navavastreṇa veṣṭayet rātrihomantu kartavyaṃ sarvadevān havirdadet prabhāte vimale tatra netrabandhaṃ visarjayet snapanaṃ kārayeddevaṃ pañcāśatpañcaviṃśatiḥ svarṇamaṅgalasūtrantu navavastrantu dāpayet sarvadevān samabhyarcya maṇḍalaṃ prati darśayet

dhṛtakṣīrābhiṣekantu nālikerantu snāpayet tāṃbūlaṃ dāpayettatra bhaktāṃśca parivārakaiḥ ācāryaṃ pūjayettatra maraṇāntaṃ vrataṃ caret ācāryastvagrato gacchet svagehaṃ praviśedbudhaḥ dūrataḥ śikharaṃ dṛṣṭvā yo naraḥ praṇamaśśivam murumuruvikramantaprādakṣiṇyaśivālaye janaispṛṣṭā tathāyāśca bhūloke tu su jīvatu pade pade śvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ jalaṃ puṣpasthalaṃ puṣpaṃ devamuddiśya nikṣipet ārāmaṃ devadevasya yo naraḥ kṛtavān bhuvi atiyutaṃ yoga * * śrotriye vedapārage kapilā pañcagavyena kuśavāriyutena ca navadhā snapanaṃ kurvan yo naro bhaktisaṃyutaḥ navamārge tu yatkarma bhoge'pi navadhā bhavet dhūpaghaṇṭā tu yo dadyā * * nir-ṛti śiṣyate nānāvastreṇa saṃpūjya nānācābharaṇaistathā bhūmiṃ gokarṇamātre tu umāpāye calātmakam devadevasyamabhitaḥ pragnivyāmekarudbhavet lokeṣu dīpavatso'pi sarvavṛttāruhasmṛtaḥ sarvadānatapoyajñaṃ prāpyate tatphalaṃ bhavet tatkṣarakṣate yena saptajanmānuyiṣyati kāñcanena vimānena śivaloke mahīyate śivalokamavāpnoti pūjyamānassa cā naraiḥ yadrūpaṃ sthāpitaṃ biṃbaṃ tadrūpo'tha bhaviṣyati ekaviṃśadgurūṇāñca tathā'sya ca vaṃśinām

mātṛpakṣe prasūtīnāṃ talloke sthānamiṣyati śivaloke naiva vā syāt sarvadevaparivrati jñānayogaṃ samāsādya sa tatraiva mucyate vāpīkūpataṭākañca devatoddiśya yatnataḥ tatrā'pi bhūyaye caiva tasya svargaṃ na saṃśayaḥ sālokyaṃ caiva sāmīpyaṃ sāyujyañcaiva yeva hi madhyaṃ staṃbhaṃ catuṣkoṇa dharmajñānādidevatam bāhyānāṃ viṃśatistaṃbhaṃ vasavo aśvinau tathā darbhamālābhirāveṣṭya puṣpamālyairalaṅkṛtam sitānāmūrdhvamācchādya netrapaṭairalaṅkṛtam aśvatthaṃ raktapatraiśca apūpairupaśobhitam gomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā prokṣayedbhūtalaṃ prati evantu maṇṭapaṃ pūrvaproktaṃ nṛttakālaṃ śṛṇuṣvahi kṣīrasnāne ghṛtasnāne madhusnāne jale'pi vā nṛttasya prathamātpūrve nārīnāṃ dīkṣaṇaṃ kuru nardako nardakaścaiva gāyako vaṃśakastathā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam hīnāṅge nāsikāṃścaiva bālo vṛddhastathaiva ca apeyapānī pāṣaṇḍī vāmā * * * varjayet grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt praviśedālayaṃ prati paścāddhomabaliṃ kuryādastradevasamanvitam rātrau tu vā baliṃ kuryāt sarveṣāṃ balimācaret aṣṭame navame vāpi gandhotsavavidhikramam taddinātpūrvarātrau tu kautuke tu naṭeśvaram etannṛttamidaṃ proktaṃ snapanaṃ tatra kārayet

gomayālepane śuddhe sthaṇḍilaṃ tatra kārayet tadardhaṃ tilasaṃyuktaṃ devāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ tathā tanmadhye tu tripāṭīnāṃ sthaṇḍiktān taṇḍulaṃ bhavet tanmadhye tantusaṃyuktaṃ bhāsaṃ candanameva ca paricārakamūrdhnistu prākāre tu pradakṣiṇam devasannidhimāpnoti puṇyāhaṃ vācayetkramāt trisūtraṃ pūrvottareṇaiva brahmajajñānamantrataḥ āpyāyasveti mantreṇa uttaraṃ rekhayetkramāt tanmadhye sthāpitaṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇamathācaret tridaśaiḥ kūrcasamāyuktaṃ puṣpagandhasamanvitam agnintu vāmapārśve tu pātrantu sādhayetkramāt ājyasthālīṃ carusthālīṃ sṛk sruvaṃ sādhayetkramāt prokṣaṇaṃ pātramādāya jalena pūritaṃ kramāt praṇītāpātramādāya toyapuṣpākṣatairyutam ājyasthālīṃ ghṛtaṃ pūrya trisparśanakūrcakam ājyasaṃsthānadarbhāṇāmāgniṃ dakṣiṇakaṃ tathā paristareṇa darbhāṇāṃ * * * * * * * * mṛdaṅgādimahāśabdaṃ pūrvāyāṃ diśi saṃsthitam nīrājanaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā stotramaṅgalavācakaiḥ nardako mardapūjyañca śuddhahemantu niṣkakam tamardako ravaiścaiva yugaṃ vastraṃ pradāpayet geyo vādyasamutpatti vādyaṃ tālasamudbhavam raṅgena vartane nṛttahastānāñcaiva nirṇayam śirohastaṃ kaṭirvakṣapuṭaraṃ pārśvasaṃyutam layanālasamāyoge cārunṛttaṃ prakalpayet

nṛttahīne tu dāridraṃ tālahīne bhayaṅkaram hṛdayaṃ vyāpitaṃ muktigalairdantaiśca jihvayā tasya madhye prāṇasthiti bindurūpaṃ parātparam saptasvaramiti proktaṃ sakale tu vidhikramam niṣādaniṣkalañcaiva sasvaraṃ sakalasya tu sakalaṃ śaktirūpaṃ syānniṣkalaṃ jīvarūpakam padmanālaṃ gato vāyu sūtikāreṇa saṃyutam svakāraṃ prāṇamityāhuḥ akārañcānalaṃ tathā ityekatā gāhikā loke caturthamardalamucyate akṣarāṇāṃ nibhaṃ kṛtvā varṇāṅgāni gāyakāḥ saugrāme vartamānañca śuddhaṣāḍavasaṃyutam aṣṭameva guruṃ pūrvaṃ madhyame laghuṣoḍaśam dhruvaṃ kā aparārpāṇyā tiṣyaṃ bandhāpi sarjanam tatkarāṅgasya pañcamyāṃ dalāmāladeśikam utsavānāṃ parīcāramadacārīgacārikā dhruvākṣiptilavañcaiva vardhamānastriyaṃ tathā āveṣṭito veṣṭitañca urveṣṭiṃ tantumeva ca bhramarīrasacārī ca karaṇañcāṅgahārikā sātvikaṃ dṛṣṭisaṃyuktaṃ śuddhanṛttaṃ vidhīyate nṛttākṣiptabahuśabdaṃ śrotraṃ gacchedbhayāvaham lokaśāntikaraṃ hyevaṃ rājarāṣṭravivardhanam atha vakramathanaṃ va prabhaṅgaṃ piṅgalajaṭāmakuṭam tridaśī deva asura gaṇavanditacaraṇam vaidyanāthacaraṇanṛttākṣiptaṃ sitavṛṣagatim tasmin gātralave subālāṃ vai bahuvinyaset

norogassa ca sahānṛtte nṛttākṣiptasamanvitam mandañjalireṣaraṅgaissiddhivratañcāyameka caturmukham ardhañcorddha nivādyaiśca vartanaṃ kamalaṃ bhavet vratagandhavanaṃ pate praviśati vanamiva sukaraṇīprāveśikaiḥ prātaḥkāle'rcanānte ca geyanṛttavihīnakaiḥ dvisandhinṛttahīne tu sāyaṃkālārcanāntakam ekāhanṛttahīne tu snapanaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ prabhūtahaviṣaṃ datvā tāṃbūlañca pradāpayet ṣaṣṭhāhañca nacedvāpi saptāṣṭanavamaṃ smṛtam guruhātvādiśaivānāṃ sagotrañcaroparopayet tatsaṃkhyā śīlakāropya tatsaṃkhyā ca tapasvinam tatsaṃkhyāśca kulālāśca tatsaṃkhyā puṣparakṣakāḥ tatsaṃkhyā kāṣṭhakārī ca gopālānāṃ tathaiva ca yāvadbalaṃ vibhavatā tāvaddhaviḥ pradāpayet dīpānāṃ bhogamevaṃ taṃ gandhārdhaṃ bhogameva tu utsavāryañca bhogañca puṣpakānāṃ bhogameva ca āgrayaṇārthañca bhogañca nyūnātiriktabhogakam devañca paricārañca devakarmiṣu sarva ca devasya śeṣaṃ yanmartyamanyakarma na kārayet supuṣṭabhogaṃ kṛtvā tu kuryādrājopakārakam ekabhāgantu dharmārthaṃ dvibhāgaṃ devaśeṣakam haimaśālī mahāśālī ratnaśālī tathaiva ca vrīhī ca sarvabhedānāṃ yavagodhūmakāni ca śuktiśca triśataṃ vrīhi dviguṇa vyūhamiṣyate vāridvayaṃ prasthamityuktaṃ tadvayañcaru āḍhakam

śivadvayaṃ droṇamityuktaṃ tadvayaṃ khānirucyate śatabhāramuttamaṃ proktaṃ pañcāśanmadhyamaṃ bhavet kṣudrantu pañcabhāraṃ syānnīcaṃ bhāradvayaṃ tathā āḍhakantu haviṃ kuryāt tadardhaṃ carurucyate gauryādi śaktināñcaiva paricārāṇāṃ tathaiva ca haviścaiva caturbhāvadvibhāgantu nivedayet haviraṣṭavidhaṃ proktaṃ mudgānnaṃ pāyasānnagam māṣānnañcaiva śuddhānnaṃ haviraṣṭavidhaṃ bhavet taṇḍulārdhañca mudgañcālpaṃ lavaṇasaṃyutam kadalīgulasaṃyuktaṃ jīrakañca marīcikā mudgañca nārikelañca panasaphalasamanvitam apūpānnamiti khyātaṃ sarvakāle tu dāpayet dadhighṛtasamāyuktaṃ pañcavarṇahavirdadet tatsamaṃ gulasaṃyuktaṃ marīcīlavaṇasaṃyutam ghṛtañca peṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā śuddhopadaṃśamucyate amlopadaṃśameteṣāṃ marīcīlavaṇaghṛtairyutam atipakvamapakvañca varjayettu viśeṣataḥ śuṣkamārdravapakvañcāmlapakvaṃ tridhā bhavet śvetaharī phalañcaiva vallīpanasameva ca śigrūmārjārakāliñca timisīmātulaṅgakam idamanyatra cidravyaṃ bhaktiyuktaṃ bhavedviduḥ anyamūlantu eteṣāṃ mūlavargaṃ dadedbudhaḥ śaktijātistu sarveṣāṃ varjayettu viśeṣataḥ marīcīsarṣapaṃ cūrṇaṃ jīrakaṃ nārikelakam ghṛtañca melayitvā tu sarvadravyāṇi saṃyutam

kṛṣikarmaphalaṃ pūrvaṃ devadevaṃ nivedayet atipakvamapakvañca varjayettu viśeṣataḥ kadalapalāśapatraṃ vā anyakṣīradrumantu vā havirūrdhvopadaṃśaiśca gulañca kadalīphalam nivedayeddhṛdā mantrī devasyatveti mantrataḥ pānīyaṃ dāpayetpaścāt caṇḍeśāya nivedayet karpūraṃ jātitakekālaṃ tailaṃ kramuphalairyutam candanañcaiva karpūraṃ kastūrīmukhasaṃyutam himācalasamāyuktaṃ rāmavat suṣire spṛśet śanivāre budhavāre ca gandhatailaṃ kṣitedbudhaḥ kuṇḍalakṣaṇamārgeṇa kuṇḍaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ koṭyāhutyaṣṭahastaṃ syāllakṣahomantu lakṣaṇam dvihastasahasraṃ homaṃ syāddhastaṃ pañcaśatādhikam dṛṣṭimātrādadhomānaṃ aṣṭahastātparaṃ na hi sthaṇḍilaṃ hastamātraṃ syāt tryaṅgulasamanvitam trirekhāprāgudagraṃ paridhī paristaraṇasamanvitam anyeṣu prāṅmukho bhūtvā sṛk sruvaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ paridhiṃ dakṣiṇārabhya prāk paridhivinā kṛtam pañcasaptāṣṭanavabhiḥ darbhaiḥ prāgādikūrcakam āyāmadvādaśāṅgulyaṃ samidhā kārayedbudhaḥ madhye tu rudrakūrcantu trimūrtiṃ sthāpayedbudhaḥ sṛk sruvañca caturdarbhaiḥ aṣṭāṅgulantu dairghyakam ekadvitrīṇi darbhāṇāṃ pavitraṃ bandhayetkramāt agraṃ yavapramāṇena tatpāśaṃ vinyasedbudhaḥ agniṃ prajvālya viharī pariṣecanamathācaret

kaniṣṭhāni mardanaṃ vā'pi prokṣayettu śivāṃbhasā paristarapūrvāgramuttarāgraṃ prakalpayet dvimukhañcaikahṛdayaṃ catuśśrotraṃ dvināsikam trimekhalaṃ tripādañca saptajihvā samāsataḥ evaṃ śivāgniṃ saṃkalpya śivamantreṇa deśikaḥ raktavarṇasitottarīyaṃ varaṃ śaktipāṇiśivāgnisvarūpakam āhavanīyañca devānāṃ tattadrūpaṃ vadāmyaham bālāgni syātpratiṣṭhānāṃ utsave yauvanāgninā kālī caiva karālī ca manoramā ca sulohitā devīlolā'sya bhāvāsyāditi śakti prakīrtitā bhavaśca pūrvādikuṇḍeṣu āgneyamugrameva ca rudrañca vāruṇe kuṇḍe bhīmaṃ vai vāyugocare triṇetrañcaturbhujañcaiva madhyame homakarmaṇi lokapālāstrahīne tu madhyame homakarmaṇi samidhaḥ sadyamantreṇa ājyaṃ vāmena hūyate īśāne sarvapañcaiva kavacena tilaṃ hunet palāśakhadire * * aśvatthaṃ vaṭavṛkṣakam bilvaṃ kapitthakañcaiva jaṃbūvakulameva ca masthaṇḍilamullekhanañcaiva apokṣaṇamagnisaṃsthitam praṇītā viṣṇumabhyarcya brāhmaṇañcārcyakūrcakam pariṣecanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā āvāgādipradakṣiṇam adite'nvādimantreṇa pariṣecanamathācaret mūrtyādidevatānāñca svasvamantraistu pūjanam sarvakarmāṇi sāmānyaṃ paścātsvakarma cintayet pañcabrahmaṣaḍaṅgañca śivasaṃskāni homayet

yāgamaṇṭapamadhye tu navabhāgaṃ prakalpayet upavedi prakartavyā dvistāraṃ caturaṅgulam pūrve tu caturaśraṃ syādāgneyyāṃ yonikuṇḍakam paścime vṛttakuṇḍantu vāyavye tu ṣaḍaśrakam indramīśānayormadhye vṛttaṃ prādhānakaṃ kuru aṣṭa hastyādimuṣṭyantaṃ kuṇmānaṃ prakīrtitam trimekhalasamāyuktaṃ mekhalamekhalameva vā vistārasamamutsedhaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulamekamekhalam tālamātraṃ ghanīkṛtya madhye kalpaṃ prakalpayet ekāṅgulantu tuṅgaṃ vāṃ dvyaṅgulamathāpi vā mekhalordhve tu yoniñca caturaṅgulamānataḥ caturaśraṃ pañcadhā kṛtvā ekāṃśaṃ purato nyaset tatkoṇādbhrāmayedanyaṃ yonyākāraṃ dvisūtrayuk sūtrakaṃ pātayitvā tu bhrāmayedardhacandrakam trisūtraṃ prāsārayedvidvān trikoṇaṃ kuṇḍamīritam bhrāmayedvṛttakuṇḍantu sarvakarmasuyogyakam karṇikāṣṭadalopetaṃ padmotsedhaṃ karīyasī ekabhāgantu nistvā * * * sūtrayuktaṃ budhaḥ kuṇḍalakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ caturaśrasya nāhavet evaṃ svaśrakuṇḍaṃ syāt sarvakāryeṣu pūjitam saptāśrañca navāśrañca padmāśraṃ ṣoḍaśāśrakam kuṇḍānāmapi sarveṣāmabhyantaramanamīritam sadāśivādidevānāṃ parivārāṇāṃ tathaiva ca dviguṇaṃ pūjayettatra arcanoktaṃ krameṇa tu śāntihomamidaṃ proktaṃ mūrtihomamatha śṛṇu

caturaśraṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā īśāne vṛttasthaṇḍilam īśāne sadāśivaṃ mantraṃ pūrve tu īśamantrakam uttare brahmamantrantu yathā śaktyā tu homayet dviguṇaṃ pūjayettatra mahāhavirnivedayet indrādyaiśānaparyantaṃ aṣṭadik diśi devatāḥ śeṣāṇyanyāni sarvāṇi agnikāryoktamācaret diśāhomamiti proktaṃ vāstuhomamiti śṛṇu vāstukuṃbhaṃ samāropya vāstudevān samarcayet aṣṭāṣṭakapadaṃ vā'pi navaṃ navapadameva vā brahmādi devamabhyarcya caskī prabhṛtirarcayet vāstudevān samabhyarcya balimantreṇa dāpayet svanādyenaiva mantreṇa samidhāñcaiva homayet vāstupuṇyāhamevantu vāstukuṃbhena toyakam ityevaṃ homamākhyātaṃ svasvairmantraistu hūyate dīyate tu śivajñānaṃ kṣīyate tu malatrayam saptāśaivamuddiṣṭamatate tāni gataśśṛṇu mandāśaivāstṛtīyantu caturthāñco tu śaivakam saptamañcāntyaśaivantu śaivabhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ādi śaivaṃ viprāṇāṃ śivena dīkṣita smṛtaḥ kauśikaḥ kāśyapaścaiva bhāradvājo maitrireva ca teṣāñca ṛṣīṇāṃ mātā caiva śivadvijāḥ ādi dīkṣitaścaturvedi śivapūjāṃ na kārayet ādiśaivena kartavyaṃ viprādīnāñca dīkṣayā * * * * * * * * punardīkṣāṃ na vidyate snapanaṃ pāgaśuddhyarthaṃ kārayettu śivadvijaḥ

adīkṣitaścaturvedī parārthapūjā na kārayet ṣaṇmāsātpatanaṃ yānti devadeva kalāsmṛtāḥ pūjayedyadi viprastu sarvadevalako bhavet sthitiliṅgañca pūjānāṃ na kurvanti kadācana rudrohyavāntaraścaiva kramaśaścānuvarṇakam ityādi pravaraśaivānāṃ antyaśaivāmatha śṛṇu ādiśaivena kartavyaṃ pratiṣṭhādyarcanāntakam vedavedāntatattvajñā ādiśaivā iti smṛtāḥ rohiṇī śravaṇañcaiva viṣṭhā trīṇi cottarā sthirarāśau prakartavye ubhaye ca śubhodaye aṣṭamasthān gṛhān sarvān parihāre tu viśeṣataḥ aṅkurārpaṇayetpūrva pūrvoktavidhinā kuru pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā ācamanaṃ vidhinā caret maṇḍapaṃ maṇḍayeddhīmān pratiṣṭhāmaṇḍapavatkuru vediṃ kuryādyathānyāyaṃ śivaliṅgaṃ maṇḍalantu vā svastikañcārdhacandrañca maṇḍalaṃ tatra ca kriyet tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā aṣṭavakraṃ sa karṇakam lājapuṣpaiśca darbhaiśca vicarettu viśeṣataḥ navakuṃbhaṃ vardhanīñcaiva gandhatoyena pūritam śivakuṃbhaṃ vidyeśañca manonmanī vinyasedbudhaḥ agnyādānādikaṃ sarvamagnikāryoktamācaret śiṣyadehantu saṃprokṣya kautukaṃ pūrvamantrataḥ nṛttageyasamāyuktaṃ vinodaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ vāmarūpāya viśvāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ prabhāte vimale sūryodaye tu kārayet

netrabandhaṃ prakartavyaṃ hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ uttamaṃ dvādaśaṃ hastaṃ daśahastantu madhyamam navavastre saṃveṣṭya jīrṇasphuṭita varjayet vastraṃ yena samāyuktaṃ netramantrantu bandhayet netraṃ balaṃ prakartavyaṃ svarṇapuṣpasamāyutam adhamaṃ pañcaniṣkantu lakṣaṇaṃ padmapuṣpavat uttarābhimukho bhūtvā ekacittena buddhimān pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā vāmadevena mantrataḥ maṇḍale vikiretpuṣpaṃ svastimaṅgalavācakaiḥ tanmantraṃ savyate tasmāt kurute cāpyanugraham nai-ṛtyāṃ śrīkaraṃ proktaṃ manuṣyantu vāyave karṇike patite puṣpe sukhañcaiva bhavettadā udakena samāyuktaṃ bhasmaṃ śirasi nikṣipet śivakuṃbhasya toyena prokṣipecchivamūrdhani aghoraṃ hṛdaye nyasya kavacastanamadhyataḥ sadyojātaṃ nyasetpādau vinyasecchiṣyadehike śikhāyāntu śikhā nyasya kavacastanamadhyataḥ devasya dakṣiṇe pārśve palāśapatrasaṃyutam āsanasthantu śiṣyañca pūrvābhimukhameva ca pādāṅguṣṭhān samārabhya dahedyāvacchirontakam candramaṇḍalasaṅkāśaṃ makārañcātmasaṃbhavam omityekena kamalaṃ yogapīṭhamadhomukham tena plāvitamātmānaṃ apūrvaṃ taṃ vicintayet na tasya jāyate mṛtyuriti śāstrasya niścayaḥ mantrādhvā ca padādhvā ca tatvādhvā bhuvanādhvakam
